name: Starweave the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Starweave receives visitors in Auberdine. Travelers come to honor Kalimdor's ancestral spirits and seek her wisdom and blessing.

sections.title: A Beacon in Auberdine
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, ancestral spirits appear across Azeroth beneath pillars of celestial light. Elder Starweave joins the night elves in Auberdine, a harbor on Darkshore's coast. Travelers come to honor her and seek guidance from ages past.

sections.title: Whispers of the Heavens
sections.body: Elder Starweave looks to the heavens above Kalimdor. She tells visitors that the stars hold answers to mortal doubts and worldly riddles. Those who seek her counsel are urged to look skyward for truth and receive ancestral favor, along with tidings of other wandering spirits across the wild frontier.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Starweave?
faq.answer: Elder Starweave can be found in Auberdine, the coastal night elf town in Darkshore. A beam of moonlight shines down from the heavens where she stands.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Visiting and honoring ancestral elders across Azeroth is part of the yearly Lunar Festival. Travelers receive recognition, festive currency, and ancestral goodwill.
Elder Starweave is an ancient night elven spirit who honors the Lunar Festival. She offers wisdom about the constellations and points pilgrims toward other revered elders, including Elder Bladeswift.

faq.q: Can Horde players visit Elder Starweave?
faq.answer: Yes. Festival elders welcome respectful travelers of either faction. Since Elder Starweave is in Auberdine, an Alliance harbor, Horde travelers must be wary of the town's night elven guards.

faq.q: What does Elder Starweave tell travelers?
faq.answer: Elder Starweave tells visitors that the stars hold answers to mortal riddles. She asks whether the wise and fortunate might look upward to find truth.

faq.q: Which elder does Starweave point to?
faq.answer: Elder Starweave shares Elder Bladeswift's location and tidings, guiding travelers onward across northern Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a night elf, honoring Elder Starweave in Auberdine connects you with the ancient spirits of your forebears and the revered mysteries of Elune and the stars.
As a druid, you hold ancestral spirits and celestial balance in deep reverence. Communion with Elder Starweave reflects those beliefs.
As a Horde traveler, you must carefully make your way into Auberdine's Alliance-held docks to pay your respects without provoking the local sentinels.
